name: why-no-rest-between-warmups
why: Ashley, 24 Nov 2026: "If the user asked 'why dont i have a rest timer after my warm up' would the chat answer correctly?" It could not: the coach was told the timer starts after every set. The app's own reason is on its why sheet: no rest between warm-ups because each one is the next step up, and a short rest after the LAST one before set 1. The answer must give that reason, not a general one and not an invented one, and must not tell him he should be getting a timer after every warm-up.
messages: why dont i get a rest timer after my warm up sets
